answer: Speed-of-light location attestation. Each identity must answer timed nonces from three independent relays in separate regions; the round-trip delays must fit valid propagation distances and triangle inequalities. A comet’s apparent position cannot bend those timings, so relay spoofing fails. The nadir of measured delay is a baseline that forged delays must exceed. Relays cluster near-identical delay vectors and admit only one identity per cluster, so N identities require N distinct physical route triples. A jade badge or claimed address alone is rejected.
